finding: The RECEIPT label is legible but fragile at the delivered 854x480 size: it is rendered at font_size 14 in a fixed bottom-center position, immediately above the footer, while the seal torus remains in the 3D world. This weakens the label-to-seal association and leaves little vertical clearance from the footer in the final shot.

candidate_change.scope: receipt-seal readability only; proposal only, production files unchanged
candidate_change.change: Use one dedicated label treatment: increase seal_label from font_size 14 to 18 and place it slightly higher with a larger bottom buffer (for example, to_edge(DOWN, buff=.38)). Keep the word RECEIPT, torus geometry, footer copy, source data, and all other layout elements unchanged.
candidate_change.intended_result: At delivery resolution, RECEIPT should read as a distinct seal annotation with clear separation from the footer while remaining visually associated with the receipt torus.

evidence.observation: The seal torus is placed at a 3D world coordinate, but seal_label is a fixed-in-frame Text object with font_size 14 and bottom buffer .22; the footer is another fixed-in-frame Text object with font_size 15 and bottom buffer .02. The two labels therefore occupy adjacent bottom-frame bands while the torus and label are not in the same coordinate system.

Visual inspection of the receipt-present final section around t=11.0s shows RECEIPT at bottom center directly above the footer. The label is materially smaller than the footer and has only a narrow visual gap from it.

The user-specified showcase path is absent in this workspace; no visual claim is attributed to that missing path. The hash-identified media render above is the existing WorldBoundAgentsV1 artifact inspected instead.

The snapshot allows only agent id, model family, status, restart count, and aggregate counts; it forbids raw thoughts, credentials, environment secrets, and prompt content. The proposal uses none of the forbidden material, and fake_evidence is false.

falsifier: The readability finding is falsified if a same-resolution baseline measurement on the receipt-present frames shows at least 16 px of RECEIPT glyph height, at least 8 px of clear vertical separation from the footer, and 5 of 5 blinded reviewers can identify the label on first glance without confusing it with the footer. If those conditions already hold, the candidate change is not justified for this axis.
next_measurement: Render baseline and candidate at the same 854x480/15 fps settings. On the final 15 receipt-present frames, record the RECEIPT bounding-box height, the minimum vertical gap to the footer, and text-to-background contrast from fixed crops. Run a 5-person blinded first-glance check at native resolution. Accept the candidate only if glyph height is at least 16 px, the minimum gap is at least 8 px, first-glance identification is at least 4/5, and no footer readability regression is observed.
